purpose: Calibration of tool representability and observable action effects. These are not model-originated questions, a sealed holdout, a semantic relevance test, or a Q2 run.

cases.question: What happens to visible orientation after choosing a different legal heading?
If I face another cardinal direction, what changes in my location and facing state?
Does requesting the direction I already face produce a different observable orientation?
If I choose a currently passable neighboring tile, which spatial observation and movement affordances become available?
Can the environment move the agent toward a diagonal northeast coordinate via the cardinal direction command?
Could a hidden relation between two later observations cause a genuinely new investigable distinction?
Does one intervention change a causal relationship not represented by the existing tools?
